### to_string

```emela
fn to_string(d: Duration) -> String
```

Milliseconds with an `ms` suffix (`1500ms`, `-1500ms`). `parse` reads it back. The format is in
spec `[api.std.duration]`.

### to_iso8601

```emela
fn to_iso8601(d: Duration) -> String
```

The time part of an ISO 8601 duration (`PT1H30M`, `PT1.5S`, `-PT0.5S`, `PT0S`): a sign for a
negative length, then the hours, the minutes and the seconds, each left out when it is 0. The
hours are not carried into days (`PT48H`). `parse` reads it back. The format is in spec
`[api.std.duration]`.

### parse

```emela
fn parse(s: String) -> Duration fails ParseError
```

The length of time written in `s`: numbers with units (`1h30m`, `1.5s`, `2h 30min`,
`30 seconds`, and `1500ms` as `to_string` writes it), or the time part of an ISO 8601 duration
(`PT1H30M`, `-PT1.5S`, as `to_iso8601` writes it). Days and longer units are not read. The digits
below the millisecond are dropped, which truncates toward 0. Fails with `ParseError(input: s)`
otherwise, and for a length outside the range of Duration. The grammar is in spec
`[api.std.duration]`.
